summary: 维多利亚国家美术馆重开后，空间、商店和展厅反映出美术馆角色的转变。作者追问如何吸引公众，同时满足展品和临时展览的需要。

paragraphs.brief: 任何对文化机构有兴趣的人都会知道，艺术博物馆正在适应社会的变化。
sentences: As anyone with even a passing interest in cultural institutions will know, art museums are adapting to keep up with changes in society.
任何对文化机构有兴趣的人都会知道，艺术博物馆正在适应社会的变化。
Do any of these newly developed spaces indicate a fundamental shift in the ways we engage with art at the beginning of the twenty-first century?
这些新开发的空间中是否有任何表明我们在21世纪初与艺术打交道的方式发生了根本变化？

The answer is a qualified Yes and also, it must be said, No. A clear sense of this can be gained by considering the 2003 redevelopment of the National Gallery of Victoria (NGV) in Melbourne, Australia’s second largest city, in the light of the aspirations embodied in the original building that served as its template.
答案是有条件的。必须指出，不。考虑到2003年澳大利亚第二大城市墨尔本维多利亚国家美术馆(NGV)的重新开发，考虑到作为该馆模板的原建筑所体现的愿望，可以清楚地认识到这一点。

paragraphs.brief: 1968年向公众开放时，第一座建筑被认为是一个完全现代化的博物馆。
sentences: The first building was considered a thoroughly modern museum when it opened to the public in 1968.
1968年向公众开放时，第一座建筑被认为是一个完全现代化的博物馆。
We should not forget that it was also bold, entrepreneurial and innovative in ways that have done great credit to the vision and foresight of the architect, Roy Grounds.
我们不应忘记，它也是大胆、有创业精神和创新精神的，对建筑师罗伊·普尔茨的远见和远见表现了极大的赞扬。
For one thing, the 1968 building signalled a strong sense of engagement with Asian and Pacific cultures, both in its architecture and through the layout of its collections.
首先，1968年的建筑表明，在建筑和通过其收藏品的布局方面，都存在着一种与亚洲及太平洋文化交往的强烈感觉。
Its entrance lobby was designed to facilitate the rapid and efficient circulation of visitors.
其入口大厅的设计是为了便利游客的迅速和有效流动。

It also contained a series of greatly expanded temporary exhibition galleries and a vast Great Hall, which represented an unprecedented emphasis on the ancillary roles of corporate functions and public performances in the contemporary museum.
它还包括一系列大为扩展的临时展览馆和庞大的大会堂，它们代表了对当代博物馆公司职能和公共表演的辅助作用的前所未有的强调。

paragraphs.brief: 最后这一特点对一些人来说可能显得过份，然而，随着博物馆越来越强调公司赞助和需要通过租房筹集更多资金，多年来它证明是多么明智。
sentences: This last feature might have seemed excessive to some, yet how wise it has proven over the years as museums have come to place increasing emphasis on corporate sponsorship, and on the need to generate additional funds via room hire.
最后这一特点对一些人来说可能显得过份，然而，随着博物馆越来越强调公司赞助和需要通过租房筹集更多资金，多年来它证明是多么明智。
Furthermore, the Great Hall has for forty years provided an area for children to roam at large before being escorted through the much less spatially accommodating galleries themselves.
此外，40年来，大会堂为儿童提供了一个在远处漫游的地方，然后由远非空间宽敞的美术馆本身护送。
As an unintimidating introduction to the lifelong rigours of visiting art museums, its impact on attendance cannot be overestimated.
作为参观艺术博物馆终生严谨的介绍，它对参观的影响怎么估计也不过分。

paragraphs.brief: 同时，1968年《国家人口和健康调查》的其他方面并没有很好地经受住时间的考验。
sentences: At the same time, other aspects of the 1968 NGV have not withstood the test of time so well.
同时，1968年《国家人口和健康调查》的其他方面并没有很好地经受住时间的考验。

Foremost among these are the huge expanse of the exterior’s windowless wall and the surrounding moat, which creates a rather unwelcoming expression of the museum as a temple of culture set apart from the everyday world.
其中最突出的是巨大的外部无窗墙和周围的护城河，这造成了博物馆作为与日常世界分开的文化庙宇的不受欢迎的表现。

Over time, this idea has been questioned, and has been superseded by the growing impetus towards the alternative model of the museum as a more open-ended and visitor-friendly forum that engages the public more effectively.
随着时间的推移，这一想法一直受到质疑，并被日益推动的博物馆替代模式所取代，该替代模式是一个更加开放和方便游客的论坛，可以更有效地让公众参与。

paragraphs.brief: 考虑到这些考虑，马里奥·贝利尼于2003年重新开发了NGV，他的设计反映了新的、经过改进的二十一世纪全球博物馆认为应该强调其参观者。
sentences: With these considerations in mind, Mario Bellini’s redeveloped NGV opened in 2003 and his design reflects what the new, improved, twenty-first century global museum feels it should be emphasising to its visitors.
考虑到这些考虑，马里奥·贝利尼于2003年重新开发了NGV，他的设计反映了新的、经过改进的二十一世纪全球博物馆认为应该强调其参观者。

Here the institution’s energies are focused, not so much on the technical subtleties of how to design the galleries themselves, as on presenting to the public a spectacular image of the museum itself as a welcoming yet efficient facilitator of social interaction, popular entertainment and public knowledge.
博物馆的精力主要集中在如何设计美术馆本身的技术细节上，而不是向公众展示博物馆本身的壮观形象，作为社会互动、大众娱乐和公众知识的欢迎而有效的促进者。
All of this is certainly impressive, but where has the art gone?
这一切当然令人印象深刻，但艺术在哪里去了？
We are not allowed to see the exhibitions until we have completed the necessary inductions.
只有在我们完成了必要的介绍之后，我们才能看到这些展览。
We are greeted by a hugely expanded cloakroom screening off our vision to the right, followed by a large visitor information office leading to the ticket booths.
我们受到一个大大扩大的衣帽间检查的欢迎，从我们的视线向右，然后是通往票亭的大型访客信息办公室。
Above us is the cafe and to our left we cannot escape the NGV shop set alongside the exit.
上面是咖啡馆左边是不能从出口旁边的NGV商店逃出去的

paragraphs.brief: 最极端的是，这导致建造新建筑，取代了内部的艺术品，成为主要景点。
sentences: And what of the redesigned galleries themselves?
重新设计的画廊呢？

In fact, they represent a wonderfully elegant reframing of the permanent collections in ways that should offer first-time visitors and seasoned members alike many new avenues for engagement in the years to come.
事实上，它们代表着永久收藏品的极优雅的重新组合，为首次来访者和有经验的成员提供了许多新的参与途径。
But herein lies the conundrum posed by the NGV renovation and by the global sweep of new museum projects more generally.
但是，这里是NGV翻修以及全球范围对博物馆新项目进行清理所造成的难题。

The mainstay elements of a permanent collection can become all too easily lost in the increased prominence that these rebranding exercises tend to place on the more glamorously spectacular aspects of the institution itself.
永久收藏的支柱要素很容易被忽略，因为这些重新品牌的作业往往使机构本身更加引人注目。
At its most extreme, this results in the construction of new buildings that supplant the artworks inside them to become the major attractions themselves.
最极端的是，这导致建造新建筑，取代了内部的艺术品，成为主要景点。

paragraphs.brief: 临时展览领域最能感受到这些挑战。
sentences: These challenges are most keenly felt in the area of the temporary exhibition.
临时展览领域最能感受到这些挑战。
Entrance to the NGV permanent collection is now free, so the NGV needs something to keep the paying public coming back.
进入NGV永久收藏现在是免费的，所以NGV需要一些东西，使付费的公众能够回来。
The answer lies in the international ‘blockbuster’ exhibition.
答案在于国际“阻击者”展览。
The Impressionists, for example, netted a total of 380,000 visitors, making it one of the most popular exhibitions in Australian history.
例如，“印象派画家”展览共吸引了 38 万名观众，是澳大利亚历史上最受欢迎的展览之一。
There has also been, it needs to be said, a commendable attempt to leaven the international masterpieces with selected highlights from the permanent collection.
还必须说，有人企图把国际杰作从永久收藏中挑选出的精选精品留下，这是值得赞扬的。
Overall, though, the prevalence of these ‘rental’ blockbusters cannot but help introduce a certain ‘off the rack’ feeling to the institution’s exhibition programme.
不过，总的来说，这些“Rental”的混混的流行性只能帮助将某种“脱衣舞”的感觉引入到该机构的展览节目中。

More importantly perhaps, they clearly narrow the options for other worthy but less glamorous projects, and they take energy away from the curators’ potential to do further work on and around the permanent collection itself.
更重要的是，它们显然缩小了其他有价值的但不太有魅力的项目的选择范围，并且它们占用了馆长在永久收藏本身及其周围进一步工作的潜力。

paragraphs.brief: 节目必须继续下去，没有公众就无法存在。
sentences: Yet the show must go on, and shows can’t exist without the public.
节目必须继续下去，没有公众就无法存在。

Even the most adroit organisation, as the NGV assuredly is, needs to be able to juggle numerous, often conflicting priorities: the need to advance scholarship, on the one hand, versus the imperative of access on the other; the need to introduce audiences to new areas, versus the necessity of luring them in with instant brand recognition.
即使是最成功的组织，正如国家志愿人员协会所肯定的那样，也需要能够把众多、往往是相互冲突的优先事项混为一谈：一方面需要提供奖学金，另一方面则需要获得奖学金；需要向受众介绍新的领域，而另一方面则需要立即给予他们品牌认可。
Nobody said it was going to be easy, and the effect of too much innovation in museums can be disastrous.
没有人说这很容易，太多的博物馆创新的影响可能是灾难性的。

items.en: What is the writer doing in the first paragraph?
correct: considering the influence of gallery design on art appreciation
考虑画廊设计对艺术欣赏的影响

items.en: The writer criticises the old NGV because
correct: the building tended to make art seem remote.
建筑往往让艺术显得很遥远

items.en: What does the writer notice about the new NGV?
items.zh: 作者注意到什么关于新的NGV?
correct: He is frustrated because the art is obscured by the entrance.
他感到沮丧，因为艺术被大门遮蔽。

items.en: The writer argues that rental ‘blockbuster’ exhibitions
items.zh: 作者认为租借的“阻击者”展览

items.en: Roy Grounds’s design failed to recognise the importance of functions and performances in museums.
items.zh: Roy Grounds的设计未能认识到博物馆功能和表演的重要性。
items.why: 格朗兹设计的大礼堂对企业活动和公共演出给予了空前重视，这正与“没有认识到这些功能的重要性”相反。

items.en: Mario Bellini’s new NGV rejects international museum design trends.
items.zh: Mario Bellini的新NGV反对国际博物馆的设计趋势。
items.why: 题干说“Mario Bellini的新NGV反对国际博物馆的设计趋势”。对照原文的表述“考虑到这些考虑，马里奥·贝利尼于2003年重新开发了NGV，他的设计反映了新的、经过改进的二十一世纪全球博物馆认为应该强调其参观者”，两者的判断相反。

items.en: Mario Bellini’s work on subsequent museum projects has been less successful than that on the NGV.
items.zh: Mario Bellini在后来博物馆项目方面的工作不如在NGV成功。
items.why: 文中介绍贝利尼改建的维多利亚国家美术馆及其设计。作者没有列出他后来的项目，更没有与这座美术馆比较成败。

items.en: The NGV monitors the number of first-time visitors to permanent collections.
items.zh: 国家志愿人员办公室监测长期收藏的首次参观者人数。
items.why: 永久展览免费，美术馆要吸引付费观众再次到访。这是关于收费与回访的陈述，没有说明馆方是否统计首次参观永久展览的人数。

items.en: Too much change may have negative impacts on museums.
items.zh: 太多的变化可能对博物馆产生负面影响。
items.why: 作者直言，美术馆创新过多可能产生灾难性后果，明确支持题干所说过度改变会有负面影响。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: If a large space is available in the museum,
items.zh: 如果博物馆有大片空间
items.answer: F · it will have the capability of increasing revenue.

items.en: If children are allowed to move freely in parts of the gallery,
items.zh: 如果允许孩子们在画廊的某些地方自由行动
items.answer: E · this will encourage museum visitors in the future.
items.solution: 这将鼓励博物馆今后参观者。

items.en: If too much emphasis is placed on the museum building itself,
items.zh: 如果过分强调博物馆本身,
items.answer: C · the art loses its importance.
items.solution: 艺术失去了它的重要性。

items.en: If there is an over-reliance on ‘blockbuster’ exhibitions,
items.zh: 如果过度依赖 " 阻击者 " 展览,
items.answer: A · the museum programme will lose its individuality.
items.solution: 博物馆计划会失去个性

items.en: If the NGV wants to continue to be successful,
items.zh: 如果国家志愿人员协会想继续取得成功,
items.answer: D · it will have to balance opposing demands.
items.solution: 它必须平衡对立的要求。

pairs: 第 5 段 · 第 5 句
第 8 段 · 第 2 句
points: 题干说“Mario Bellini的新NGV反对国际博物馆的设计趋势”。对照原文的表述“考虑到这些考虑，马里奥·贝利尼于2003年重新开发了NGV，他的设计反映了新的、经过改进的二十一世纪全球博物馆认为应该强调其参观者”，两者的判断相反。
题干问“如果博物馆有大片空间”。定位句写到“最后这一特点对一些人来说可能显得过份，然而，随着博物馆越来越强调公司赞助和需要通过租房筹集更多资金，多年来它证明是多么明智”。
clauses: We are not allowed to see the exhibitions ….
连接词 until 引出“until we have completed the necessary inductions”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 until 把这一层关系补进去。
The mainstay elements of a permanent collection can become all too easily lost in the increased prominence ….
“that these rebranding exercises tend to place on the more glamorously spectacular aspects of the institution itself”补足 become 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 become 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: A study of the reopened National Gallery of Victoria
重新开放的维多利亚国家美术馆研究
